title: Local ASR synthetic quality and paced latency regression

hardware.inference: CPU int8, 4 threads; no verified NVIDIA GPU
hardware.machine_exclusivity: Shared host; background work may affect latency.

safety.fixtures: Two installed Windows synthesis voices; in-memory TTS -> ignored .local PCM.

scoring.primary: Existing SpeechBench WER, unchanged; compound word tokenization counts as errors.
scoring.secondary: Character edit distance over normalized words joined without spaces; all engines identical.
scoring.latency: Wall time from last clean synthesized sample >=100/32768 to last nonempty final; fixed before adding noise.
scoring.cold: Fresh-process model import/verification/load and first row are reported; OS file cache is uncontrolled. No row omitted.
scoring.silence: Three nonspeech cases retain any final insertion/hallucination errors. Provisional text may still be wrong.

runs.normalization: NFKC, lowercase, percent sign -> percent, digit numerals -> English cardinal words (num2words), apostrophes removed, other punctuation -> spaces; no stop-word removal or engine-specific substitutions. Colon times split into two cardinals; decimal points become point. Acronyms are not expanded.

experiments_retained.interpretation: The first long run passed runtime/PCM checks but failed the harness's rotation coverage assertion. Injected 30-second windows exposed 44 word insertions on Computer. A bounded 0/0.2/0.4-temperature retry exceeded the 20-second native-call deadline and visibly faulted; its incomplete scores are not comparable to completed runs. The 15-second probe reduced that source to two insertions. The first production 15-second dual run then reached the shared Vosk intake's 32-frame bound and visibly faulted. Dedicated bounded source queues/workers replaced that shared hybrid intake. The adopted parallel 15-second path is remeasured without endpoint injection.

production_setup_check.final_text: write me the solution for the LeetCode problem to sum

default_selection.rationale: Retains fast provisional text; stronger local final model reduces errors on this corpus. Disclosed general technical terms improve proper-name spelling and character errors. Raw WER remains visible: LeetCode as one token costs two word edits against leet code, so hinted small.en has a higher raw WER than unhinted small.en, but lower than Vosk. Unrelated and nonspeech final outputs did not regress here.
default_selection.remaining: One synthesized target case uses to instead of two, and two use some instead of sum. Longer speech has additional model errors; byte-exact ownership does not imply zero word errors. Nothing is claimed 100 percent accurate.
